description_en: Modifies a circuit breaking rule by calling the ModifyDegradeRule operation
description_zh: 调用ModifyDegradeRule接口修改降级规则
name: ModifyDegradeRule

parameters.help_en: The threshold type, which specifies the circuit breaking strategy. A value of 0 indicates circuit breaking based on the slow request ratio. A value of 1 indicates circuit breaking based on the exception ratio
parameters.help_zh: 阈值类型，即降级的策略，取值为0时表示按慢调用比例降级，取值为1时表示按异常比例降级
parameters.name: strategy

parameters.help_en: The circuit breaking threshold corresponding to the threshold type. Circuit breaking is triggered for the API when this value is exceeded
parameters.help_zh: 阈值类型所对应的降级阈值，超过该值时会触发接口的降级
parameters.name: threshold

parameters.help_en: The ID of the circuit breaking rule
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en: The circuit breaking duration. During this period, all requests to the API fail immediately. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 熔断时长。在该时间段内，该接口的请求都会快速失败，单位毫秒
parameters.name: recovery_timeout_ms

parameters.help_en: The statistical window duration. Unit: milliseconds. Default value: 1000
parameters.help_zh: 统计窗口时长，单位MS。默认值为1000
parameters.name: stat_duration_ms

parameters.help_en: The slow request response time (RT). A request whose response time exceeds this value is counted as a slow request. This parameter is required when the threshold type is set to slow request ratio
parameters.help_zh: 慢调用RT。请求的响应时间超过该值时统计为慢调用。阈值类型为“慢调用比例”时需设置该字段
parameters.name: slow_rt_ms

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of requests required to trigger circuit breaking. If the number of requests in the current statistical window is less than this value, the circuit breaking rule is not triggered even if the circuit breaking condition is met. Default value: 5
parameters.help_zh: 触发熔断的最小请求数目，若当前统计窗口请求数小于此值，即使达到熔断条件规则也不会触发。默认值为5
parameters.name: min_request_amount

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of requests allowed to pass through per step during circuit breaking recovery. Default value: 5
parameters.help_zh: 熔断恢复每步最小通过数目，默认值为5
parameters.name: half_open_base_amount_per_step

parameters.help_en: The number of recovery steps during circuit breaking recovery. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 熔断恢复阶段数，默认值为1
parameters.name: half_open_recovery_step_num
